result.description: LumenArc 27QW is a fictional 27-inch desktop monitor designed for studio, office, and content-review workflows. It features a 3840x2160 IPS panel, 60Hz refresh rate, 350 nits typical brightness, and 99% sRGB coverage for accurate everyday color work. Connectivity includes DisplayPort 1.4, HDMI 2.0, and a USB-C upstream port with 65W power delivery. The matte chassis uses a slim bezel design, an adjustable stand, and built-in low blue light modes for long viewing sessions.
